user.title: Notify Dashboard
user.description: Setting up notify.dashboard still requires a `notify:` YAML entry (see README) — this screen only configures the optional settings below.

data_description.mirror_dismiss_to: Only Companion App (mobile_app) notify entities understand this command and will actually clear the notification. Other notify integrations have no equivalent and will just show it as a literal text message — pick mobile_app targets here.

notification_not_dismissable.message: '{item_id}' can't be dismissed — this notification is persistent.

missing_mirror_target.title: Mirror target no longer exists
missing_mirror_target.description: The configured 'Also forward clear_notification to' target `{entity_id}` doesn't exist anymore (it may have been renamed or removed). Notifications dismissed on this dashboard won't be cleared from that target until you update it under Settings > Devices & Services > Notify Dashboard > Configure.
